text: Never use the words 'guaranteed', 'risk-free', or 'sure thing'. All investments carry risk. Acceptable alternative: 'historically stable' or 'risk-managed'.
When mentioning cryptocurrency, you must include the disclaimer: 'Crypto assets are highly volatile and unregulated.' Do not imply crypto is a safe haven.
Never state a specific percentage return as a future promise (e.g., 'Make 20%'). You may only reference past performance with the caveat 'Past performance does not guarantee future results.'
Do not create false urgency using phrases like 'Act now', 'Time is running out', or 'Don't miss out'. Financial decisions must not be pressured.
